description: Main service entry point for a repository diff tool, managing configuration loading, starting HTTP handlers, and orchestrating various controllers.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point initializing configuration, starting handlers, and running controllers.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs enabled controllers and manages overall job status.

methods.name: getEnabledControllers
methods.description: Returns a list of controller functions that are enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: disabledFnNullified
methods.description: Wraps a controller function to disable it if not enabled.

methods.name: topLevelErrorHandle
methods.description: Handles errors at top-level, updates status channel, and logs the error.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Loads application configuration from JSON file.

methods.name: formattedError
methods.description: Formats an error into a string for logging and messaging.
